content.json:
# Overnight Summary

What happened in this subscription while nobody was watching. Default range is the last 24 hours. Start at the top and work down; if the first three sections are empty, the night was quiet.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where CategoryValue == "Alert"
| extend Rule = tostring(parse_json(Properties).eventProperties)
| summarize Count = count(), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by OperationNameValue, Level
| order by Last desc
content.title: Alerts fired

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where CategoryValue == "Administrative" and ActivityStatusValue in ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where OperationNameValue !has "/read"
| summarize Changes = count(), FirstChange = min(TimeGenerated), LastChange = max(TimeGenerated) by Caller
| order by Changes desc
content.title: Changes by caller

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where CategoryValue == "Administrative" and ActivityStatusValue in ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where OperationNameValue has_any ("/write", "/delete")
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, OperationNameValue, ResourceGroup, Resource = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1]), CallerIpAddress
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Write and delete operations

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where CategoryValue == "Administrative" and ActivityStatusValue in ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where OperationNameValue has_any ("/write", "/delete")
| summarize Changes = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Changes over time

content.json:
## 3. Denied by policy

Attempts that the landing zone guardrails blocked. A spike here usually means someone is working against the standard, or the standard is wrong.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where CategoryValue == "Policy" or (CategoryValue == "Administrative" and ActivityStatusValue == "Failed" and ActivitySubstatusValue == "RequestDisallowedByPolicy")
| summarize Denials = count(), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Caller, OperationNameValue
| order by Denials desc
content.title: Policy denials

content.json:
## 4. Machine health

Only populated once virtual machines are onboarded to the workspace with the Azure Monitor Agent.

content.query:
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, OSType, ResourceGroup
| extend MinutesSilent = datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastHeartbeat)
| extend Status = iff(MinutesSilent > __HEARTBEAT_MINUTES__, "Silent", "Reporting")
| order by MinutesSilent desc
content.title: Heartbeat status

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where Namespace == "LogicalDisk" and Name == "FreeSpacePercentage"
| extend Disk = tostring(parse_json(Tags)["vm.azm.ms/mountId"])
| summarize FreePercent = round(min(Val), 1) by Computer, Disk
| order by FreePercent asc
| take 20
content.title: Lowest free disk space

content.json:
## 5. Log volume

What is filling the workspace. Watch for a table that jumps; that is where the bill comes from.

content.query:
Usage
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024, 2) by DataType
| order by GB desc
content.title: Ingestion by table

content.query:
Usage
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024, 3) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Ingestion over time

content.json:
## 6. Key Vault access

Denied requests to any Key Vault sending diagnostics to this workspace.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT" and Category == "AuditEvent"
| where ResultSignature in ("Forbidden", "Unauthorized")
| summarize Denials = count(), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Resource, CallerIPAddress, identity_claim_appid_g
| order by Denials desc
content.title: Key Vault denials by caller IP
